fusions.name: Beak-Side Finish
fusions.desc: Reaches up to 4 tiles with the hooked back of your weapon, dealing 20 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach, and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one. It has a 50% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Grapnel Weight
fusions.desc: Throws a hooked weight that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Close
fusions.desc: Catches up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaff Stroke
fusions.desc: Against a target low on health, your damage rises by 15%.
